statement.zh: 阿拜多斯（Umm el-Qaab）前王朝王墓 U-j 及其早期书写证据见 Dreyer《Umm el-Qaab》I（1998）。「最早文字」排名留假说栏。
statement.en: At Abydos (Umm el-Qaab), Predynastic royal tomb U-j and its early writing evidence are documented in Dreyer Umm el-Qaab I (1998). “Earliest writing” rankings stay in the hypothesis column.
